# Understand {{ sno }} network reconfiguration {#cnf-understanding-sno-ip-configuration}

Use the {{ lcao }} to change the network configuration of a {{ sno }} cluster without performing a full redeployment. This is critical for many edge computing use cases such as disaster recovery and network rehoming.

**Additional resources**

- [Installing the {{ lcao }} using the CLI](/openshift-docs-markdown/edge_computing/image_based_upgrade/preparing_for_image_based_upgrade/cnf-image-based-upgrade-install-operators#cnf-image-based-upgrade-installing-lifecycle-agent-using-cli_install-operators)
